```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# Load and tidy Dataset 1: Pre-competition weight cut & fight-day rebound (32 athletes)
weight_cut <- read_excel("data/weight_cut_mma.xlsx", sheet = 1) |>
  slice(c(38, 39, 40, 41, 45)) |>
  mutate(metric = c("start_weight_kg", "weighin_weight_kg", "fight_weight_kg", "height_m", "result_code")) |>
  select(-atletas) |>
  pivot_longer(-metric, names_to = "athlete_id", values_to = "value") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) |>
  drop_na(fight_weight_kg) |>
  mutate(
    pct_weight_cut = (start_weight_kg - weighin_weight_kg) / start_weight_kg * 100,
    pct_rebound = (fight_weight_kg - weighin_weight_kg) / weighin_weight_kg * 100,
    outcome = case_when(
      result_code == 1 ~ "Win",
      result_code == 2 ~ "Loss",
      result_code == 3 ~ "Draw / No Contest"
    )
  )

# Load and tidy Dataset 2: Wrestler longitudinal weight, body fat %, muscle mass, grip strength & HRV (20 wrestlers x 5 phases)
wrestler_anthro_raw <- read_csv("data/wrestler_anthro.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(Boy))

wrestler_hrv_raw <- read_csv("data/wrestler_hrv.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  rename(
    HRV1 = DetrHRV,
    HRV2 = TrainingHRV,
    HRV3 = HighTrainingHRV,
    HRV4 = FormHRV,
    HRV5 = `MüsabakaHRV`
  )

wrestler_long <- bind_cols(wrestler_anthro_raw, select(wrestler_hrv_raw, HRV1:HRV5)) |>
  mutate(wrestler_id = row_number()) |>
  select(wrestler_id, matches("^(VA|Yag|kaskg|EKdom|HRV)[1-5]$")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -wrestler_id,
    names_to = c("metric", "phase_num"),
    names_pattern = "([A-Za-z]+)([1-5])",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  drop_na(value) |>
  mutate(
    phase = factor(
      phase_num,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Detraining", "Training", "High-Intensity", "Tapering", "Competition")
    ),
    metric_label = recode(
      metric,
      "Yag" = "Body Fat (%)",
      "kaskg" = "Muscle Mass (kg)",
      "EKdom" = "Grip Strength (kg)",
      "HRV" = "Heart Rate Variability (HRV)",
      "VA" = "Body Weight (kg)"
    )
  )

# Load and tidy Dataset 3: Elite combat sports body composition (68 athletes)
combat_body_comp <- read_excel("data/combat_body_comp.xlsx", sheet = 1, .name_repair = "minimal") |>
  select(1:16) |>
  set_names(c(
    "sport_code", "age", "weight_kg", "height_cm",
    "triceps_mm", "subscapular_mm", "biceps_mm", "iliac_crest_mm",
    "supraspinale_mm", "abdominal_mm", "mid_thigh_mm", "calf_mm",
    "arm_relaxed_cm", "arm_flexed_cm", "waist_cm", "hip_cm"
  ))
```

```{r}
# Plot pre-competition weight cut (%) vs. fight-day rebound (%) by match outcome
ggplot(weight_cut, aes(x = pct_weight_cut, y = pct_rebound, color = outcome)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "gray60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Pre-Competition Weight Cut vs. Fight-Day Rehydration Rebound",
    subtitle = "Combat athletes almost completely rebound the percentage of body mass lost before weigh-ins",
    x = "Weight Cut Before Weigh-In (% of Starting Body Mass)",
    y = "Weight Rebound by Fight Day (% of Weigh-In Mass)",
    color = "Match Outcome",
    caption = "Source: Prospective Interventional Study of Pre-Competition Weight Management (Figshare)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Plot longitudinal physiological and body composition changes across 5 wrestling phases
wrestler_long |>
  filter(metric != "VA") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = phase, y = value, group = wrestler_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25, color = "steelblue") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2, color = "firebrick") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5, color = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Longitudinal Physiological Tracking of Competitive Wrestlers Across 5 Phases",
    subtitle = "Faint blue lines show 20 individual wrestlers; bold red line shows the team mean from off-season to competition",
    x = "Training & Competition Phase",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Longitudinal Wrestler HRV & Anthropometric Tracking Study (PLOS ONE / Figshare)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
# Load and plot Dataset 4: High-level combat athletes Rapid Weight Loss (667 athletes)
rwl_combat <- read_excel("data/rwl_combat_667.xlsx", sheet = 1) |>
  filter(weight_cutting_usuallykg > 0) |>
  mutate(sex = str_to_title(sex))

ggplot(rwl_combat, aes(x = weight_cutting_usuallykg, y = weight_regain_nextweekcomp, color = sex)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0.15, alpha = 0.45, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Usual Pre-Competition Weight Cut vs. Post-Competition Weight Regain (n = 667)",
    subtitle = "Athletes who cut more weight before weigh-ins experience proportionally larger post-competition rebound",
    x = "Usual Weight Cut Before Competition (kg)",
    y = "Weight Regained in Week After Competition (kg)",
    color = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: Trends in Weight Loss Strategies in High-Level Combat Athletes (Figshare, n = 667)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Load and plot Dataset 5: Olympic Wrestling Biometrics (5,246 wrestlers)
olympic_wrestlers <- read_csv("data/olympic_wrestlers.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    division = case_when(
      Sex == "F" ~ "Women's Freestyle",
      style == "Freestyle" ~ "Men's Freestyle",
      TRUE ~ "Men's Greco-Roman"
    )
  )

ggplot(olympic_wrestlers, aes(x = Height, y = Weight, color = medal_status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ division) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Medalist" = "goldenrod3", "Non-Medalist" = "steelblue4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Height vs. Competition Weight Across 5,246 Olympic Wrestlers",
    subtitle = "Comparing Women's Freestyle, Men's Freestyle, and Men's Greco-Roman medalists and non-medalists",
    x = "Height (cm)",
    y = "Weight (kg)",
    color = "Olympic Result",
    caption = "Source: 120 Years of Olympic History Dataset (n = 5,246 wrestling entries)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
